title: Bangyao (Brian) Zhao
text:
Welcome to my personal website!
I received my Ph.D. in Biostatistics from the University of Michigan in 2025, under the supervision of Professor Jian Kang. My dissertation, Bayesian Machine Learning Methods for Brain-Computer Interface Applications, focuses on developing computationally efficient Bayesian learning and sequential decision-making methods for non-invasive EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs).
